channel.title: Game news | CTRL+A GAME
channel.description: Verified gaming news from every platform: launches, free games, deals and updates. Every story links to its official source.

item.title: Pokémon Pokopia's Apples to Applin event runs until December 1
item.description: An apple-themed event brings Applin and its evolutions to Pokémon Pokopia towns on Switch 2.

item.title: Xbox's 25th anniversary magazine is now open to everyone
item.description: Xbox's 25th anniversary special magazine is live on Xbox Wire and readable by anyone.

item.title: Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Vital Signal lands December 1 and splits Ranked in two
item.description: Ubisoft has revealed Year 11 Season 4: a Doc remaster, separate Solo/Duo and Flex ranked playlists, and the new MBZ-19 SMG.

item.title: Delta Force explains Brakkesh 2.0 faction jobs and new combat routes
item.description: The developer post details persistent badge progress, control-room routes and rival squad hunts.

item.title: Slay the Spire 2 beta hotfix fixes a Turkish Timeline freeze
item.description: Beta v0.113.1 addresses Turkish Fool progression and duplicate entries in Run History.

item.title: LoL New Dawn gets a teaser: full reveal in January, release later in 2027
item.description: Riot's official schedule separates the detailed presentation from the eventual release.

item.title: WoW: Forever hotfixes: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza and an Action Bar fix
item.description: Blizzard's November 13, 2026 hotfix list covers the weekly fishing tournament and an Action Bar bug.

item.title: Blizzard publishes the WoW: Forever short story "Cost of Honor"
item.description: The official WoW site now lets you watch the WoW: Forever short story "Cost of Honor".

item.title: Selaco Chapter 2: The Machines of War is out with 19 new maps
item.description: The Early Access shooter's biggest update adds a 6–8 hour campaign, but old saves will not carry over.

item.title: PS5 QSSR: Spider-Man 2 update is live, with more games to follow
item.description: PlayStation confirms separate rollout windows for the next QSSR game updates.

item.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra is live on PC and console
item.description: Grinding Gear Games' new expansion went live on November 13; there is a workaround for a waypoint crash on the Russian language setting.

item.title: Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds heads to PS5 in May 2027
item.description: Ocelot Technologies reveals the PS5 release window alongside a new trailer.

item.title: Xbox Wire: buy by November 19 for the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+
item.description: For purchases before 23:59 on November 19; pre-install is open on Xbox.

item.title: Fable's new Deepwood gameplay shows how spell choices shape combat
item.description: Playground Games discusses the new area and a fully upgraded Dash in the official Xbox podcast.

item.title: Diablo 30th anniversary event Legacy of Terror starts in Diablo II: Resurrected
item.description: The event runs from November 13 to 19, 2026 and launches the Season 16 Ladder.

item.title: Battlefield 6 is free to try until November 16
item.description: EA's four-day free trial began on November 13; all you need is the free Battlefield REDSEC download.

item.title: Wolfenstein 3 officially announced, in production at MachineGames
item.description: At Xbox's 25th anniversary event, Wolfenstein 3 was confirmed to be in development at MachineGames.

item.title: Nintendo Black Friday: Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle at $499.99
item.description: Digital game sales start November 19, with the Mario Kart World bundle and physical game deals from November 22 (US).

item.title: New Knight Online servers opened on November 12
item.description: NTTGame announced that new servers opened on November 12, 2026 at 16:00.

item.title: Knight Online update: Event Manager NPC items and ended events
item.description: The November 12, 2026 update notice covers the Event Manager NPC and events that have ended.

item.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting Firefight in a free update
item.description: The four-player co-op PvE mode Firefight arrives this winter as a free update.

item.title: YouTube hosts a 24-hour launch livestream
item.description: The pre-show starts at 11 PM ET on November 18 and it ends live from Miami.

item.title: Fortnite v43.10 Treasure Hunters update is out
item.description: The update adds a Locker grid density button, a High Quality Assets option for PC and new Sprites.

item.title: Knightica is free on the Epic Games Store until November 19
item.description: Epic's weekly freebie is Knightica until November 19; Alien: Isolation and Mark of the Deep follow on November 19.

item.title: VALORANT Patch 13.10: replay bookmarks, new assist rules, Gauntlet: Glitched
item.description: Patch 13.10 brings replay bookmarking, changes to assist rules and Gauntlet: Glitched updates.

item.title: PS Plus Game Catalog for November: Death Stranding 2 and Like a Dragon join
item.description: The PlayStation Blog revealed the November Game Catalog, led by Death Stranding 2, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii and Atomfall.

item.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 8: Ender Dragon flight fix and new languages
item.description: Snapshot 8 fixes Ender Dragon flight and adds Javanese and Chavacano support plus snow tweaks.

item.title: Marathon's Symbiosis update lands December 8 with new PvE and PvP modes
item.description: Bungie set the Symbiosis update for December 8, adding new modes, weapons and a new Runner shell.

item.title: Football Manager 27 is out now, including with Game Pass
item.description: FM27 launched on Xbox on PC and FM27 Console on Xbox Series X|S, both available with Game Pass.

item.title: Nintendo eShop adds digital game gifting for family groups
item.description: From November 16, family group members on Switch and Switch 2 can gift digital games to each other.
